name: moe_split_w13_v1
hypothesis: Batch32 decode is weak (1.466x), with ~60% of candidate time in paired gate/up. Split the 4096-wide W13 K dimension across four CTAs, write FP32 gate/up partials, reduce them and apply the original BF16 rounding + SiLU epilogue, then retain the existing W2 and norm path. This trades one reducer launch for shorter WGMMA/MMA loops and 4x W13 CTA parallelism.
